card.name: The word withdrawal in benzodiazepine warnings
card.fires_on: The word withdrawal (or its ending -al after Withdraw) in the heading and text about acute withdrawal reactions after stopping benzodiazepines or similar drugs.

modes.label: Withdrawal heading
modes.description: The ending of Withdrawal in the heading Acute Withdrawal Reactions in benzodiazepine labels.

modes.label: Withdrawal in running text
modes.description: The whole word withdrawal after acute or a drug name, in sentences about stopping a drug.
modes.example: Abrupt discontinuation or rapid dosage reduction of oxazepam after continued use may precipitate acute<< withdrawal>> reactions, which can be life-threatening.

card.plain: It lights up on the word withdrawal when a label discusses reactions to stopping a benzodiazepine.
